description:
One NFT's prices on GONDI: what it is listed for, the top bid on
it, its last sale, its estimated value and whether it is collateral in
an open loan, and what the seller nets selling at the listing's price
or into the top bid on GONDI against OpenSea. Answers "what's this NFT
listed for", "what's the top bid on Y" and "what do I keep if I accept
it". It takes a collection slug and a token id: when you have a
name, call search_gondi first and take both from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the NFT's collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

token_id.description: The NFT's token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: get_nft_market

status.description: loan_initiated while the loan runs; loan_sent_to_auction or loan_defaulted once it was not repaid in time.
status.title: Status

EstimatedValue.description: GONDI's estimate of what the NFT is worth, always in ETH.

basis.description: The market evidence the estimate rests on, such as FLOOR_BID_BLEND, TRAIT_FLOOR, SALE_HISTORY, ITEM_BID or LAST_SALE.
basis.title: Basis

confidence.description: 0 to 1; how much market evidence backs the estimate.
confidence.title: Confidence

EstimatedValue.title: EstimatedValue

amount_usd.description: At the rate of the sale's time; null when none was recorded.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

marketplace.description: Where the order or sale lives; GONDI for GONDI's own.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

MarketOrder.description:
A listing or a bid: an order someone signed and that is still open.
Its amount is its price, which is what the buyer or bidder pays.

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

buyer_fee_percent.description: The GONDI fee the listing's buyer or the bid's bidder pays, as a percent of the price its maker set; already inside buyer_pays, never on top of it. 0 on every listing and every regular bid; only a stealth bid's publication fee (STEALTH_BID_PUBLICATION) and a BuyNowPayLaterOrder's fee fall on the bidder.
buyer_fee_percent.title: Buyer Fee Percent

buyer_pays.description: What the listing's buyer or the bid's bidder pays in total, in currency_symbol: the listed price for a listing, the bid for a bid. GONDI's seller fee comes out of the seller's proceeds, not on top of this. Buying with a loan adds its own fee (get_buy_with_loan_quote).
buyer_pays.title: Buyer Pays

gondi_fee_percent.description: The SELLER's GONDI fee when the order executes, as a percent of its price, at GONDI's current rates. It comes out of the seller's proceeds and never adds to what the buyer or bidder pays (buyer_pays). It is the sale fee (SALE), a stealth order's (STEALTH_ASK, STEALTH_BID_EXECUTION) or a sell-and-repay listing's (SELL_AND_REPAY), and 0 on CryptoPunks. It is 0 for another marketplace's order: GONDI adds nothing, and that marketplace's own fee, such as OpenSea's, is inside the price and comes off the seller's proceeds. Creator royalties are not included; the order does not say which of its fees they are.
gondi_fee_percent.title: Gondi Fee Percent

maker_address.description: The seller of a listing, the bidder of a bid.
maker_address.title: Maker Address

marketplace.description: Where the order or sale lives; GONDI for GONDI's own.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

order_type.description: What the order is placed on: one NFT (SingleNFTOrder, and the SellAndRepayOrder and BuyNowPayLaterOrder listings), every NFT of the collection (CollectionOrder), those with one or several traits (TraitOrder, MultipleTraitOrder) or a chosen set of them (SetBidOrder).
order_type.title: Order Type

MarketOrder.title: MarketOrder

SellerNet.description:
What the seller receives from a sale at `price`, after the marketplace's
fee and before any creator royalty, which comes off either way.

price.description: What the sale pays, in whole tokens.
price.title: Price

SellerNet.title: SellerNet

active_loan.description: The open loan the NFT is collateral in; null when it is not locked in one.

estimated_value.description: Null when nothing in the market prices the NFT.

listing.description: What the NFT is listed for: its cheapest open public listing; null when it is not for sale.

listing_seller_net.description: What the seller nets selling at the listing's price as a GONDI listing, after the fee its seller pays (gondi_fee_percent, such as a sell-and-repay listing's), against as an OpenSea listing; null when it is not for sale.

top_bid.description: The highest open bid the NFT can be sold into, whether placed on it or on its collection, its traits or a set it belongs to; null when there is none.

top_bid_seller_net.description: What the seller nets accepting the top bid through GONDI, against a bid of the same amount on OpenSea. net_on_gondi takes off GONDI's fee from a GONDI bid and OpenSea's from an OpenSea bid, and is null for another marketplace's bid, whose fee is unknown here; null when there is no bid.

title: NFT market
